title: Junior Data Scientist
description: Entry-level data scientist role. You will clean and analyze large datasets, build predictive models, and communicate insights to stakeholders. Comfort with statistics, experiment design, and machine learning fundamentals is essential.

title: NLP Engineer
description: Build natural language processing pipelines: text classification, named entity recognition, and semantic search. Experience with transformer models, embeddings, and large language models is highly valued.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Design, train and deploy machine learning models at scale. Own the full MLOps lifecycle from experimentation to serving, including model monitoring and retraining pipelines.

title: Data Analyst
description: Turn raw business data into dashboards and actionable recommendations. Strong SQL, Excel and visualization skills, plus the ability to explain trends to non-technical teams.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Develop responsive, accessible web interfaces with React. You will own component libraries, optimize performance, and collaborate closely with designers and backend engineers.

title: Full-Stack Engineer
description: Build end-to-end features across a modern web stack. Work with React on the client, Node or Python services on the API layer, and cloud deployment tooling.

title: Backend Engineer
description: Design scalable APIs and microservices handling high transaction volumes. Strong grasp of databases, caching, concurrency and system design required.

title: Data Engineer
description: Build and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines. Model data warehouses, ensure data quality, and enable analytics teams with reliable datasets.

title: AI Research Intern
description: Support research on generative models and retrieval-augmented systems. Read papers, reproduce baselines, run experiments, and prototype evaluation harnesses.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: Own reporting and KPI tracking for product and growth teams. Build semantic layers, write complex SQL, and present insights clearly to leadership.

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description: Develop image and video understanding models for industrial inspection. Experience with CNNs, detection and segmentation frameworks, and model optimization.

title: MLOps Engineer
description: Own CI/CD for machine learning: feature stores, model registries, automated evaluation, canary releases and monitoring in Kubernetes environments.

title: Product Analyst
description: Analyze user funnels and run A/B tests to guide product decisions. Partner with PMs and engineers to define metrics and measure impact.

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Provision and automate cloud infrastructure, design reliable architectures, and improve cost and security posture across AWS environments.

title: Conversational AI Engineer
description: Design and ship LLM-powered assistants: prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation, guardrails and tool calling integrations.
